en.headline: Four franchised bus operators apply for fare rises of 8.1 to 17.7 per cent
en.dek: Citybus seeks the largest increase at 17.7 per cent and Kowloon Motor Bus 16 per cent, citing high fuel costs; lawmakers will discuss the applications on Friday.
body: Four franchised bus operators have applied for fare increases ranging from 8.1 to 17.7 per cent, according to a paper the Transport and Logistics Bureau submitted to the Legislative Council on Wednesday.

Citybus has requested 17.7 per cent, Kowloon Motor Bus 16 per cent, New Lantao Bus 9.8 per cent and Long Win Bus 8.1 per cent. Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said lawmakers would examine the applications at a panel meeting on Friday.

The bureau said passenger numbers on franchised buses remained below pre-pandemic levels, while operators faced rising costs, particularly from high diesel prices linked to conflict in the Middle East. It noted that fuel procurement costs for the operators rose sharply earlier this year.

Chan said the government would review the applications carefully, balancing the operators’ financial sustainability and service reliability against public affordability. She added that the government would reduce or reject increases it considered excessive after considering the full range of factors under the fare adjustment arrangement.
The last fare increases for Kowloon Motor Bus, Citybus and New Lantao Bus were approved in 2024 and took effect in January 2025. Long Win Bus’s previous increase was in 2023.

zh.headline: 四間專營巴士營辦商申請加價8.1%至17.7%
zh.dek: 城巴申請加幅最高達17.7%，九巴申請16%，指受高油價影響；立法會周五將討論有關申請。
body: 運輸及物流局周三向立法會提交文件，四間專營巴士營辦商已申請加價，加幅由8.1%至17.7%不等。
城巴申請加價17.7%，九巴申請16%，嶼巴申請9.8%，龍運申請8.1%。運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，立法會議員將於周五的委員會會議檢視有關申請。
局方指，專營巴士乘客人次仍低於疫情前水平，而營辦商面對營運成本上升，尤其是中東戰事引致柴油價格高企。文件顯示，營辦商今年較早前的燃料採購成本大幅上升。
陳美寶說，政府會審慎檢視申請，平衡營辦商的財務可持續性、服務可靠性與公眾負擔能力。她補充，經考慮票價調整安排下的各項因素後，如認為個別加幅過高，政府會調低或拒絕申請。
九巴、城巴及嶼巴上一次加價於2024年獲批准，並於2025年1月生效。龍運上一次加價則在2023年。
